I’m using the GitHub PR workflow skill to anchor the review to the actual PR metadata and change set; I’ll keep the work read-only.

The local checkout is one commit behind the PR head and has unrelated uncommitted files; I’ll preserve those and review the fetched PR refs directly, without switching or editing the worktree.
